decisions.review_notes: Both seeds visibly expand blue paint to cover most of the canvas and retain that committed state. Roller width/shape changes and motion is intermittent, costing one point each. No scene reset/cut or automated long-freeze run detected. Coverage reaches a plateau early: valid for committed-state retention, weak for continual state updating. Completion means most covered, as specified, not edge-to-edge coverage. Review provenance is assistant sampled visual inspection.
